title: OpenClaw behavior correlation pack
notes: This pack targets the OpenClaw gateway with full metadata monitoring.
The expected telemetry sources are Linux auditd syscall events, systemd-resolved debug metadata, and OpenClaw/Xray runtime logs.
The rules are intentionally tuned to burst conditions to avoid alerting on every single metadata event.
Suppression key: host.name + process.name + rule family. Interactive and privileged actions escalate only after threshold or on explicit high-risk event types.
Expected OpenClaw DNS success traffic and known transient proxy runtime noise are allowlisted in normalization before stream correlation.

stream_rules.title: OpenClaw Outbound Connection Burst
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect the destination set and recent operator actions. Validate whether the burst is tied to the expected browser/session workload.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: OpenClaw Outbound Connection Burst
id: sigma-openclaw-outbound-connection-burst
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: linux
  service: auditd
detection:
  selection:
    event.provider: linux.auditd
    host.name: openclaw-gateway
    event.type: linux_network_connection
  condition: selection
level: high
tags:
  - openclaw
  - network
  - egress

stream_rules.title: OpenClaw DNS Query Burst
stream_rules.operator_action: Check whether the DNS fan-out is expected for the current OpenClaw tasking and review the resolved hostnames in the event stream.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: OpenClaw DNS Query Burst
id: sigma-openclaw-dns-query-burst
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: linux
  service: systemd-resolved
detection:
  selection_provider:
    event.provider: linux.systemd-resolved
    host.name: openclaw-gateway
  selection_message:
    message|contains: "Regular transaction"
  condition: selection_provider and selection_message
level: medium
tags:
  - openclaw
  - dns
  - egress

stream_rules.title: OpenClaw Privileged Configuration Change
stream_rules.operator_action: Validate that the change belongs to an approved maintenance window. Review the exact file or command in the audit event payload.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.auditd' and host.name == 'openclaw-gateway' and (event.type == 'linux_audit_config_changed' or event.type == 'linux_sudoers_modified' or event.type == 'linux_rsyslog_config_modified' or event.type == 'linux_sshd_config_modified' or event.type == 'linux_firewall_modified' or event.type == 'linux_firewall_disabled' or (event.type == 'linux_systemd_unit_modified' and (event.original icontains '/etc/systemd/system/' or event.original icontains '/lib/systemd/system/' or event.original icontains '/usr/lib/systemd/system/') and not event.original icontains '.dpkg-' and not event.original icontains 'dpkg-tmp' and not event.original icontains 'dpkg-new' and not event.original icontains 'dpkg-old' and not event.original icontains 'nametype=PARENT' and not event.original icontains 'apt.systemd.daily' and not event.original icontains 'unattended-upgrade')) and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: OpenClaw Proxy Error Burst
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect Xray/OpenClaw runtime logs and recent route changes. Only persistent non-allowlisted proxy failures should page the operator.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: OpenClaw Proxy Error Burst
id: sigma-openclaw-proxy-error-burst
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: linux
  service: openclaw
detection:
  selection_host:
    host.name: openclaw-gateway
  selection_process:
    process.name:
      - xray
      - node
  selection_message:
    message|contains:
      - error
      - failed
      - timeout
      - broken pipe
  condition: selection_host and selection_process and selection_message
level: medium
tags:
  - openclaw
  - proxy
  - runtime

stream_rules.title: OpenClaw Suspicious Interactive Privilege Activity
stream_rules.operator_action: Review the exact SSH or privileged control-change event and confirm whether the activity belongs to an approved operator maintenance window.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: OpenClaw Suspicious Interactive Privilege Activity
id: sigma-openclaw-suspicious-interactive-privilege-activity
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: linux
  service: auditd
detection:
  selection_host:
    host.name: openclaw-gateway
  selection_type:
    event.type:
      - audit_exec_as_root
      - linux_root_ssh_login
      - linux_user_added_to_admin_group
      - linux_systemd_service_disabled
      - linux_systemd_service_enabled
  condition: selection_host and selection_type
level: high
tags:
  - openclaw
  - privilege
  - interactive

batch_rules.title: OpenClaw New-Destination Review
batch_rules.description: Batch review for newly observed DNS names and outbound destinations tied to OpenClaw sessions.
